user_story: As a user, I want to verify that the links on the Links page issue API calls that return the correct HTTP status responses so that I can ensure the application is functioning as expected. Acceptance Criteria: 1. When I click on the link with text 'Created', the URL should not change, and the expected error should be handled. 2. When I click on the link with text 'Unauthorized', the URL should not change, and the expected error should also be handled.
